sources.name: European Commission · CSDDD
sources.reason: Track HRDD duties, amendments, applicability dates and scope; relevant to regulatory impact and governance studies.

sources.name: EU Forced Labour Regulation
sources.reason: Track forced-labour product restrictions, enforcement arrangements and corporate risk exposure, separating applicability from enforcement outcomes.

sources.name: EUR-Lex · EU Legal Documents
sources.reason: Check legal provisions, consolidated versions, amendments, announcements and national transposition; primary basis for institutional variables.

sources.name: International Labour Organization (ILO)
sources.reason: Forced-labour definitions, fundamental labour standards, OSH, trade-union rights and labour statistics.

sources.name: Business & Human Rights Resource Centre
sources.reason: Corporate human rights allegations, company responses and cross-border supply chain case leads; corroborate against primary reporting.

sources.name: OECD · Responsible Business Conduct
sources.reason: Due diligence guidance, supply chain governance, stakeholder engagement and remediation.

sources.name: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI)
sources.reason: European labour policy, collective bargaining, OSH and labour research; complement company disclosures with workers' perspectives.

sources.name: International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC)
sources.reason: Global labour rights, freedom of association and collective bargaining, supporting outcome and institutional comparisons.

sources.name: ETH Zurich · Supply Chain Management Group
sources.reason: Follow research in supply chain management, network governance and social sustainability; this site is independent of ETH.

sources.name: Crossref · Scholarly Metadata
sources.reason: Discover recent scholarly publications, DOIs, titles and dates. Publication quality and designs require manual review.

sources.name: Google News · Topic Monitoring
sources.reason: Query-based discovery of potential leads. Aggregated results are not primary evidence; trace the original publisher.

sources.name: Eurostat · Official European Statistics
sources.reason: Supply-chain sectors, trade, labour markets and official statistics for defining populations and covariates in policy evaluation.

sources.name: German Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs (BMAS) · Supply Chain Due Diligence Act
sources.reason: Official German LkSG requirements and institutional enforcement framework; distinguish applicable law from press summaries.

sources.name: OECD · National Contact Points Case Database
sources.reason: Non-judicial grievance cases, alleged breaches and reported outcomes; case selection and reporting biases must be considered.

sources.name: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
sources.reason: Occupational health and safety evidence, survey data and risks relevant to worker outcomes in European value chains.

sources.name: World Benchmarking Alliance · Corporate Human Rights Benchmark
sources.reason: Comparative company HRDD and remedy indicators; scores are methodology-dependent proxies, not confirmed violations.

sources.name: KnowTheChain · Forced Labour Benchmarks
sources.reason: Sector benchmarks on corporate action against forced-labour risks in supply chains; assess coverage and scoring limitations.

sources.name: European Labour Authority (ELA)
sources.reason: Official EU labour mobility cooperation, cross-border inspections, enforcement coordination and worker-protection research; not a complete incident database.

sources.name: Eurofound · European Working Conditions Survey
sources.reason: Cross-national probability survey of working conditions and worker outcomes; examine questionnaires, weights, country coverage and survey microdata access terms.
